units.text: The WHO 2025 World Malaria Report recognizes 47 countries and one territory as malaria free, with Egypt, Georgia, Suriname and Timor-Leste as the most recently certified.

citations.title: WHO Certifies Countries as Malaria Free in Face of Persistent Antimalarial Drug Resistance | Contagion Live

judgement.reason: The passages state that the WHO 2025 World Malaria Report recognizes 47 countries and one territory as malaria free, with Egypt, Georgia, Suriname, and Timor-Leste as the most recently certified.

units.text: WHO announced Georgia as malaria-free on 23 January 2025, bringing the total to 45 countries and one territory; later certifications including Timor-Leste raised the count to 47 countries and one territory.

judgement.reason: The passages support Georgia's malaria-free certification on 23 January 2025 and the total of 45 then 47 countries and one territory, but they do not mention Timor-Leste or that later certifications included Timor-Leste.
